An external dependency such as a payment gateway or fraud detection API is intermittently failing or timing out.
Database connection pool exhaustion or query contention causes connection acquisition timeouts on roughly 30% of checkout transactions.
A recent database schema migration or data inconsistency causes order creation queries to fail on specific cart configurations.
